personality_one_liner: A chunky, highly-tactile, cheerful space built of friendly, oversized modules that reward exploration and make handwriting feel like play.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing to prevent accidental taps for children. Minimum touch target height must be 64px.

dont's: Do not use blur/glass on kid interfaces; keep surfaces solid, chunky, and highly contrasted for distinct tactile modules.

screens.name: ProfilePicker
screens.purpose: A welcoming, zero-friction entry screen for kids to tap their avatar, and a hidden top-corner gateway for parents.

states.empty: No kids added yet. Show a friendly 'Add Kid' large dashed pill.

screens.layout: Grid of massive, rounded cards (minimum 120x120px) displaying animal avatars and large names. 64px 'Add Profile' CTA. A discrete, muted icon in the top-right triggers the Parent PIN modal.

screens.name: KidDashboard
screens.purpose: Shows daily progress at a glance and lists the available handwriting lessons (word lists).

states.empty: Illustration of an open book with 'Ask parent to add words!'

screens.layout: Top section: Daily practice goal (Circular progress indicator in Mustard Yellow) alongside a trophy badge. Below: 2-column grid of word list cards (e.g., 森林, 兔子). Each card must have pill-shaped 'Play' buttons. Cards are surfaceSecondary with soft shadows.

screens.name: PracticeScreen
screens.purpose: The core tablet workspace holding the hanzi-writer WebView, multi-mode toggles, and gamification rewards.

states.empty: N/A - loaded directly with character data.
states.error: Failed to load character engine. Show retry button.

screens.layout: Tablet-optimized layout. Top header: Large Pinyin and English meaning with a chunky Coral 'Pronounce' icon button. Center: The Tianzige/Mizige grid (WebView minimum 320x320px) framed in a surfaceSecondary container with borderStrong. Right edge: Vertical stack of 1-3 reward stars. Bottom: 3-tier mode toggle (Demonstrate, Trace, Test) presented as massive pill segments. Bottom corners contain Next/Previous buttons utilizing animal mascot icons.

screens.name: ParentMode
screens.purpose: A utility interface strictly for adding/editing Chinese word lists and managing kid profiles, secured by PIN.

states.empty: No custom lists. 'Create your first word list'.

screens.layout: Visually isolated from the kid experience (use surfaceTertiary backgrounds). Simple, structured single-column lists. Text inputs for adding characters (split into single character cards). Standard table layouts for progress tracking.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile/Playful LIGHT personality (4). No dark mode needed unless explicitly requested, as this is an early learning app.
Implement the 'hanzi-writer' inside a WebView component, sizing it at least 320x320px with the Tianzige background drawn beneath or within the canvas.
Ensure the Parent Mode is visually 'boring' compared to the kid mode (using gray/neutral surfaces) so children do not feel compelled to interact with it.
For all kid-facing interactive elements, set the touch target to a minimum of 64px to support developing motor skills.
Integrate 'canvas-confetti' and soft audio feedback based on the character completion/error triggers. Wire these alongside the Haptic events.

Avoid any use of banned colors (all shades of Blue except the specific Mint/Coral accents chosen here). Note: The brand colors deliberately avoid blue/indigo to maintain compliance with <Colors> while remaining child-friendly.
Ensure 'Nunito' is loaded as the global text and display font via expo-font.
